budget_adapter.rule: Rank hyperedges by the baseline score, retain their incidences in ranked-prefix order, and truncate only the boundary hyperedge to obtain exactly K incidences.
budget_adapter.tie_break: Original hyperedge ID, then original incidence order.
budget_adapter.fixed_self_loops: One fixed singleton self-loop per node is used outside K for every method.

spectral_prefix.hyperedge_score: Sum over incident nodes of a Hutchinson-CG estimate of diag((L+reg*I)^-1) for the Zhou hypergraph Laplacian
spectral_prefix.resource_policy: Record OOM or numerical failure; do not silently replace the estimator.

statistics.pairing: Use the same model seed as EHGNN-F
statistics.new_family: EHGNN-F versus Degree-prefix and Spectral-prefix over 4 datasets x 4 budgets x 2 baselines
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction over the 32 new comparisons
statistics.random_comparison: Use the paper's conservative 20-comparison correction for EHGNN-F versus Random-Fixed.
